hud.objective: Steps: [U] Undock -> [I] Ignite -> [SPACE] Blast Off -> [B] Drop Boosters

boosters.title: Twin Rocket Boosters
boosters.subtitle: Super Power for Blast Off!
boosters.whyThereBody: These two white boosters give over 75% of the push needed to blast off Earth!
boosters.whyDetachBody: After 2 minutes they run out of fuel—we drop them so Orion can zoom fast to space!

rocket.title: SLS Rocket & Orion
rocket.subtitle: Deep Space Exploration Vehicle
rocket.whyThereBody: Special orange foam keeps the super-cold fuel inside from boiling before launch!
rocket.whyDetachBody: Orion keeps its 4 solar wings tucked safely inside during launch, then opens them in space!

dock.title: Launch Tower & Bridge
dock.subtitle: Astronaut Boarding Gate
dock.whyThereBody: Astronauts walk across this bridge into Orion's hatch before launch!
dock.whyDetachBody: The arms swing clear before blast off so the rocket doesn't bump the tower!

iss.title: International Space Station
iss.subtitle: Live Real-Time Orbital Telemetry
iss.whyThereTitle: Where is the ISS right now?
iss.whyThereBody: Tracked in real time using live orbital coordinates when VITE_NASA_API_KEY is configured in .env!
iss.whyDetachBody: The ISS travels at ~27,600 km/h (7.66 km/s) at ~418 km altitude, circling Earth every 90 minutes!
